evals.prompt: I need to add a paginated GET /api/users endpoint to our Flask REST API. We have Flask-SQLAlchemy with a User model already (id, username, email, created_at). The endpoint should support ?page=1&per_page=20 query params and return a JSON response with results, total count, and pagination metadata. Write me an implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: A complete implementation plan with header, file structure map, bite-sized tasks, complete code in each step, and no placeholders
expectations: The plan includes the REQUIRED SUB-SKILL line in the header
The plan has a Goal section in the header
The plan has an Architecture section in the header
The plan has a Tech Stack section in the header
The plan maps out which files to create and modify with Create/Modify labels
All steps contain complete code in code blocks (no TBD, TODO, or placeholders)
Each task follows TDD pattern: test -> run to fail -> implement -> run to pass -> commit
Steps include exact command-line commands with expected output
The plan has a Self-Review section
The plan has an Execution Handoff section offering execution options
Tasks use - [ ] checkbox syntax for tracking
Git commit commands are included at the end of each task
